exposure: adequacy of gestational weight gain (low, adequate, excess)
cohort: Pregnant women with a BMI at delivery of 30 kg/m2 or more, at 24 weeks gestation or more
finding: Women with prepregnancy bariatric surgery experienced differences in perinatal outcomes, including higher odds of preterm birth, low birth weight, congenital anomalies, cesarean deliveries, and higher gestational weight gain compared to those without bariatric surgery.
